text:
sam: heads up - staging pods oom/killed by runtime because of SELinux deny + cosign verify failing on a handful of images.

liam: which images? any logs?

sam: one example: gcr.io/redwood/agent:2026-04-10-rc1
cosign verify output: 
```
Error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = permission denied for KMS signer
```
and dmesg shows avc: denied { write } for /run/secrets on the container start.

rachel: two separate issues then: (1) KMS IAM for cosign SA got stripped, (2) new baseimage added a stricter SELinux context for /run which breaks our entrypoint.

sre-oncall: any customer impact?

sam: only staging so far; canary didn't progress. rollout gate prevented prod.

audit-bot: AuditEvent: IAMPolicyChange actor=ops-sync@redwood time=2026-04-10T03:02:11Z change=removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner from serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

liam: rebind command (run as infra-admin):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/containers/cryptoKeys/signer \\n  --member=\"serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \\n  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner\"
```

liam: i'll re-add binding and trigger attest job. rachel can you file a quick revert on the baseimage SELinux change?

rachel: already opened builders/PR#740 to revert the selinux label tweak. also adding a unit test to catch context changes.

images-team: after IAM fix we can re-run cosign verify and regen any missing envelopes. if the old signatures were made with a destroyed key version we'll need to rebuild and sign. pipeline sign cmd: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/containers/cryptoKeys/signer <image>`

liam: iam rebind done. audit log: ActionLog: iam_binding_added actor=liam@redwood target=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/containers/cryptoKeys/signer time=2026-04-10T03:25:00Z

sam: attest re-run shows 5 images verified, two needed regen and were re-signed by CI.

sre-oncall: monitoring canary. no errors in last 10m.

rachel: postmortem items: (1) add ops-sync exclusion for cosign SA or add explicit allowlist; (2) CI preflight to confirm attestation upload + KMS bindings post-rotation; (3) builder test to assert SELinux contexts for runtime-critical dirs. PRs: infra/PR#921, ci/PR#412, builders/PR#741.

sam: thanks all. documenting runbook update: if SELinux denies + cosign permission errors appear together -> do not relax admission, fix IAM, revert builder context change, re-run attests, validate canary.

liam: pinged @sre-oncall when canary hit 5% and again after 30m. :white_check_mark:
